_readme: Course/unit weights control how often real-feel exam questions are drawn from each. Any course_slug or unit key NOT listed here defaults to 1.0 (equal weight). Unit keys are 'course-slug|unit-slug'. These are STARTING target-emphasis values on a 0.6-2.5 tier scale, NOT yet volume-corrected - run check_weight_balance.py (now provided) once fetch_articles.py has produced real per-course question counts, so actual appearance % matches these intended targets rather than being skewed by which course has more generated content. 'excluded_from_real_feel' lists courses filtered out of the real-feel pool entirely (not just weight=0) - study articles and regular practice for these courses are untouched, they just never appear in the simulated NMCN exam.
